records.title: Why Does Reinforcement Learning Generalize? A Feature-Level Mechanistic Study of Post-Training in Large Language Models
records.reason: This is a mechanistic study of why RL post-training generalizes; it analyzes training effects rather than proposing inference efficiency.

records.title: Beyond "I Don't Know": Evaluating LLM Self-Awareness in Discriminating Data and Model Uncertainty
records.reason: The paper evaluates LLM uncertainty/self-awareness and abstention behavior; no concrete serving, latency, cache, or compute reduction is described.

records.title: ProtoCycle: Reflective Tool-Augmented Planning for Text-Guided Protein Design
records.reason: The work is a tool-augmented protein-design planning system for a domain task, without an inference-engine efficiency contribution.

records.title: MAISI: Medical AI for Synthetic Imaging
records.reason: MAISI combines CT volume compression, diffusion, and tensor-splitting parallelism for high-resolution medical-image synthesis. Its compression/parallelism is for 3D imaging networks, not LLM inference or PyTorch LLM serving.

records.title: UltraMedical: Building Specialized Generalists in Biomedicine
records.reason: UltraMedical builds biomedical model capabilities/specialization; the abstract does not describe inference-time compute or serving optimization.
